title: Document SPEAR world save and share process in README
objective: Add the world archive/share guidance to the repository README so other developers can find how to save, share, and restore SPEAR worlds.
instructions: Update the root README.md, not example or third-party READMEs, with a concise section that points developers to the save/share process.

Use Scout's archive guidance: source-level world folders are Content/SPEAR/Scenes/<world>; .umap alone is insufficient; runnable builds are Standalone-Development/Linux with monolithic SpearSim-Linux.pak; Infinigen outputs are regeneration/provenance sources.
Include exact paths for the current imported worlds: college_classroom, one_bed_apartment, and infinigen_indoors_0000.
Keep README concise; link or point to docs/importing_and_exporting_assets.md for detailed workflow where appropriate.
constraints: Do not edit product source code.
expected_outputs: Root README.md updated with save/share/archive guidance.
ResultPacket listing changed docs and any follow-up gaps.
definition_of_done: README contains actionable save/share guidance for other developers.
No product code or Git operations performed.
